title: Add required kind to LandingCommit with per-kind validation
summary: Add a required snake_case `kind` enum (job_landing, declared_intervention, records_only) to LandingCommit in history.rs, make job/verification optional and enforced by validation per kind, update tests, and set job_landing in the one gh.rs builder. pr_commits stays for part 2.

defaults_applied.how: Update and add tests; run athena-data and athena-core tests, clippy clean.
Only history.rs and the one gh.rs builder; pr_commits left for part 2.
Criteria check rejection and round-trip behavior via cargo test.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: let Landing records classify commits so part 2 can land PRs with records-only and intervention commits; audience is the athena maintainer and verifier.
job and verification must become Option<..> on LandingCommit with skip_serializing_if, since non-job kinds must not claim a job; the validation lives in Landing::validate.
Non-job kinds also must not carry a verification (reading 'must not claim a job' as covering both fields).
Other users of Landing commits (manage.rs, display.rs) only pass them through and need no change; the existing gh.rs test constructor at ~3788 and history.rs test at ~411 need the new field.

acceptance_criteria.text: LandingCommit in history.rs has a required `kind` field of a snake_case enum with exactly job_landing, declared_intervention, records_only; deny_unknown_fields is kept; job and verification become optional (omitted when absent).
Run `cargo test -p athena-data`: Landing::validate rejects a job_landing entry lacking job or verification, and rejects declared_intervention/records_only entries that carry a job or verification.
Run `cargo test -p athena-data`: each kind round-trips through JSON; parsing rejects an unknown kind, a missing kind, and an unknown field.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core gh`: the gh.rs commits() builder sets kind job_landing with job and verification, and existing landing tests (around line 3788) pass; pr_commits in land.rs is unchanged.
`cargo clippy -p athena-data -p athena-core` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.

out_of_scope: Changing pr_commits in land.rs or content-based classification (part 2)
Changes to athena-gate or the CLI display
